objective: Select the smallest authorized B with conservative identity-blind Holm-adjusted rejection power at least 0.90 for every one of P1-P4; report S1-S2 planning power without using it for selection.

nuisanceEstimator.sourceUnits: eight opaque workload sources with two timing replicas per source across the same 24 structural batches
nuisanceEstimator.pseudoBlockConstruction: sample 16 opaque workload sources with replacement; sample one of two replicas for each selected lane; preserve each selected source's full 24-dimensional timing vector; apply frozen ordinal-mod-worker assignment and reconstruct worker makespan
nuisanceEstimator.batchCalibration: identity-blind observed batchWall/reconstructed-makespan calibration constant; fixed constants are removed by centering
nuisanceEstimator.processJitter: independent zero-mean log jitter with sigma=max(0.03, pooled centered duplicate-log-difference/sqrt(2))
nuisanceEstimator.observedEffectsRemoved: center all six structural estimands before covariance; never serialize means or observed directions
nuisanceEstimator.smallSourceUncertainty: variance multiplied by df/chi-square-lower-0.05(df), df=7, Wilson-Hilferty approximation
nuisanceEstimator.psdRule: symmetrize and raise eigenvalues below maxEigenvalue times 1e-10

powerSimulation.primaryMethod: one-sided Holm strong FWER across P1-P4
powerSimulation.keySecondaryMethod: gate opens only when all P1-P4 are rejected; then one-sided Holm across S1-S2
powerSimulation.powerPerHypothesis: Monte Carlo probability of rejection under the applicable frozen procedure
powerSimulation.primaryPassRule: minimum Wilson lower bound across P1-P4 is at least 0.90
powerSimulation.selectionRule: first passing B in ascending order

runtimeGate.actionAtOrAbove: stop before final implementation and schedule freeze and submit a simplified MQ proposal

outputSuppression: no condition identifiers from qualification rows
no fitted or observed effect means
no qualification direction rank weight or winner
failClosed: Any hash schema cardinality ordinal positivity covariance or finite-value violation terminates without selecting B.
